src.grid.make_radial_grid

src.grid.make_radial_grid(r_first)[source]

Build the initial radial grid in log-space. ln_r_edge[0] = -np.inf and ln_r_edge[1:] = linspace(ln_r_first, ln_r_outer, n_shell).

Parameters:

r_first (float) – first non-zero cell edge

Returns:

initial radial grid

Return type:

array-like
